description: Conservation background statistics, CAP cavity geometry, and summary figure of the PI15 structural analysis
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SEQ='MIAISAVSSALLFSLLCEASTVVLLNSTDSSPPTNNFTDIEAALKAQLDSADIPKARRKRYISQNDMIAILDYHNQVRGKVFPPAANMEYMVWDENLAKSAEAWAATCIWDHGPSYLLRFLGQNLSVRTGRYRSILQLVKPWYDEVKDYAFPYPQDCNPRCPMRCFGPMCTHYTQMVWATSNRIGCAIHTCQNMNVWGSVWRRAVYLVCNYAPKGNWIGEAPYKVGVPCSSCPPSYGGSCTDNLCFPGVTSNYLYWFK'
cons=np.load('work/cons_pi15.npy')
scan=pd.read_csv('work/pi15_P1_scan.csv')
cap=cons[60:211]  # mature CAP region conservation background
print('Conservation background, PI15 mature CAP domain (res 61-211), n=%d'%(~np.isnan(cap)).sum())
print('  median %.2f  mean %.2f  frac >=0.95: %.2f  frac >=0.93: %.2f'%(np.nanmedian(cap),np.nanmean(cap),
      np.nanmean(cap>=0.95),np.nanmean(cap>=0.93)))
for p in [131,133,202,128]:
    pct=100*np.nanmean(cap<cons[p-1])
    print(f'  {SEQ[p-1]}{p}: id={cons[p-1]:.2f}, percentile within CAP domain = {pct:.0f}')

# CAP tetrad geometry
AA3to1=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
at=[]
for line in open('work/PI15_human.pdb'):
    if line.startswith('ATOM') and line[17:20].strip() in AA3to1:
        at.append((line[12:16].strip(),line[17:20].strip(),int(line[22:26]),
                   np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])))
def sidetip(r, nm):
    want={'HIS':['NE2','ND1'],'GLU':['OE1','OE2'],'GLN':['OE1','NE2']}[nm]
    return [a[3] for a in at if a[2]==r and a[0] in want]
tet={112:'HIS',123:'GLN',145:'GLU',172:'HIS'}
print('\nCAP cavity (His-Gln-Glu-His) pairwise min side-chain-tip distances (A):')
ks=list(tet)
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(i+1,4):
        d=min(np.linalg.norm(p-q) for p in sidetip(ks[i],tet[ks[i]]) for q in sidetip(ks[j],tet[ks[j]]))
        print(f'   {tet[ks[i]][0]}{ks[i]} - {tet[ks[j]][0]}{ks[j]}: {d:.1f}')

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
tm=pd.read_csv('work/tmalign_results.csv')
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))

ax=axes[0,0]
sub=tm[tm['query']=='PI15_CAP(66-211)'].sort_values('TMscore')
colors=['#2b7bba' if 'CAP' in r or 'crisp' in r or 'triflin' in r or 'Ves' in r or 'ASP' in r else '#c0504d' for r in sub.ref]
ax.barh(sub.ref, sub.TMscore, color=colors)
ax.axvline(0.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(0.51,0.2,'TM 0.5\nsame fold',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('TM-score (PI15 CAP domain as query)'); ax.set_title('a. PI15 CAP domain matches CRISP/CAP folds,\nnot Kunitz or Kazal inhibitor folds',fontsize=10,loc='left')

ax=axes[0,1]
sub=tm[tm['query']=='PI15_Cterm(212-258)'].sort_values('TMscore')
ax.barh(sub.ref, sub.TMscore, color='#808080')
ax.axvline(0.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=1)
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_xlabel('TM-score (PI15 C-terminal Cys-rich domain as query)')
ax.set_title('b. The C-terminal cysteine-rich domain matches\nno canonical inhibitor fold (all TM < 0.17)',fontsize=10,loc='left')

ax=axes[1,0]
ax.scatter(scan.loop_rmsd, scan.rsa, s=60, c='#2b7bba', edgecolor='k', zorder=3)
for _,r in scan.iterrows():
    if r.loop_rmsd<2.0: ax.annotate(f'{r.aa}{r.resi}',(r.loop_rmsd,r.rsa),fontsize=8,xytext=(3,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvspan(0,0.62,color='#9ecae1',alpha=.5,zorder=0)
ax.text(0.05,0.08,'spread among 4 real\ncanonical P1 loops\n(0.26 - 0.62 A)',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("backbone RMSD of P3-P3' segment to canonical inhibitor loops (A)")
ax.set_ylabel('relative solvent accessibility of the residue')
ax.set_title('c. No Arg or Lys in mature PI15 adopts a canonical\nreactive-site-loop conformation (best 1.37 A)',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.set_xlim(0,3.4); ax.set_ylim(0,1)

ax=axes[1,1]
x=np.arange(61,259)
ax.plot(x,cons[60:258]*100,lw=1,color='#555555')
for p,lab in [(112,'H112'),(123,'Q123'),(145,'E145'),(172,'H172')]:
    ax.plot(p,cons[p-1]*100,'o',color='#d62728'); ax.annotate(lab,(p,cons[p-1]*100),fontsize=8,xytext=(-6,6),textcoords='offset points',color='#d62728')
for p in [131,133,202]:
    ax.plot(p,cons[p-1]*100,'s',color='#1f77b4'); ax.annotate(SEQ[p-1]+str(p),(p,cons[p-1]*100),fontsize=8,xytext=(-6,-14),textcoords='offset points',color='#1f77b4')
ax.set_xlabel('human PI15 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('% identity across 187 vertebrate PI15 orthologs')
ax.set_title('d. The CAP cavity tetrad is invariant (with a fixed Glu to Gln change);\ncandidate P1 arginines are no more conserved than background',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.set_ylim(40,103)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
